entries.name: Ronald Satchel

expected.charges: Attempted murder; weapons charges (indicted, later dropped)
expected.sentence: Wounded and taken into custody following the December 4, 1969 raid on the Chicago apartment where Fred Hampton and Mark Clark were killed. Released on $25,000 bond December 15, 1969, according to the same-day FBI teletype recording Chicago police information. The later dismissal of the indictments in 1970 was not his custody-release date.

updates.sentence: Wounded and taken into custody following the December 4, 1969 raid on the Chicago apartment where Fred Hampton and Mark Clark were killed. Released on $25,000 bond during December 1969. FBI reports give conflicting release days, December 13 and December 15; the exact day remains unresolved. The later dismissal of the indictments in 1970 was not his custody-release date.

entries.rationale: Additional FBI report on PDF page 58 conflicts with the December 15 daily summary: it explicitly states release December 13. Supersede batch 688 exact day with month precision; do not retain an exact duration from conflicting dates.

entries.name: J. Robert Jones

expected.sentence:
One year in federal prison for contempt of Congress.

Verdict as recorded: Yes — cited for contempt of Congress in 1966 and convicted; the conviction was upheld on appeal.

Charges as recorded: Contempt of Congress — for refusing to produce the Ku Klux Klan’s membership and financial records subpoenaed by the House Un-American Activities Committee.

entries.rationale: PBS documents entry into federal custody in 1969. Contemporary Daily Iowan June 3, 1970 report explicitly documents release from Danbury in January 1970. Do not treat January 8 advance announcement of planned January 9 release as confirmed actual day. Do not turn one-year sentence into actual duration.
